theme_and_archetype.rationale: Cybersecurity storytelling requires a clinical, authoritative, and tense atmosphere. We avoid the clichéd 'matrix green' in favor of a high-end, forensic documentary aesthetic. Deep obsidian backgrounds with functional, high-contrast accents (Signal Red for attacks, Cyan for defense).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing: py-24 for sections, gap-12 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento 'Control Room' grid for dashboards/stats. Asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for storytelling narrative sections.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid borders (border-collapse, 1px border-white/10) for data-heavy sections like IOCs and Kill Chain phases.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (#121212), 1px solid border-white/10, no soft shadows. Hover: border-white/30 and subtle -translate-y-1.
surfaces.timeline: Vertical tracing beam style. A solid left border with a moving gradient highlight to denote the progression of the attack.
surfaces.glass: Backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 and 1px inner border-white/10 for sticky navigation and AI chat panel overlays.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky crystal glass header (z-50). Must include language switcher (TR/EN) and AI Assistant trigger.
components_strategy.hero: Cinematic text overlay (Outfit font, font-light) over a max bg-black/50 darkened abstract image.
components_strategy.timeline: Custom HTML/Tailwind vertical timeline. Left border line, glowing dots for timestamps, JetBrains Mono for dates.
components_strategy.kill_chain_diagram: Grid-based horizontal/vertical flow. Use SVG dashed lines and Framer Motion to animate a 'tracing beam' (data exfiltration path) across the phases.
components_strategy.ai_chat_panel: Slide-out or floating glassmorphism panel. Input field at bottom, chat bubbles with monospace font for technical output.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI forms for Community Submissions. Dark themed, square corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm max).
components_strategy.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='lang-switch-button', data-testid='attack-card-log4j').

motion_and_interaction.hover: High contrast shifts. Muted text becomes pure white. Borders glow slightly with accent colors.
motion_and_interaction.scroll: Fade in and slide up (using Framer Motion) for timeline events to mimic uncovering forensic evidence.
motion_and_interaction.diagrams: Use animated SVG paths (stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset) to simulate attacker lateral movement.

hero_background.description: Coding screengrab, darkened for hero background

attack_solarwinds.description: Vibrant orange network lines representing supply chain

attack_wannacry.description: Red lock on keyboard representing ransomware

attack_moveit.description: Dewy spider web representing file transfer mesh

media.icons: lucide-react for UI interactions. Use sharp, technical icons (Terminal, ShieldAlert, Activity, Network).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@300;500;700&display=swap');
Configure Tailwind with the specified font families, extending the default sans to Outfit and mono to JetBrains Mono.
Build the Timeline component using a left border and relative positioned dots.
For the MITRE kill chain, create a horizontal or vertical step-by-step layout with connected borders. Use framer-motion to create an animated 'tracing beam' effect on the borders.
Implement the AI chat panel as a fixed position sliding drawer (Shadcn Sheet or custom) with a distinct glassmorphic background.
Ensure the localization (TR/EN) state is managed globally (React Context or Zustand) and affects all narrative content.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively for the attack cards and hero section. DO NOT use placeholder services.
